description:
Give `ValidationReport` the provenance each finding needs and a selection operation, so every validation view can be computed as a filter of the one report.

## Background

- `ValidationReport` holds findings projected to the wire `ReportedFinding` (`crates/jit/src/validation/report.rs:24`), which keeps the attributed issue, rule, severity and message only. A view also needs each finding's origin (local rule, graph rule and whether it is repository-wide at transition, or a built-in pass), its firing subject (graph findings record it) and whether it is a configuration error. The report also records whether it carries the history verdicts (record fidelity and document references), which only whole `jit validate` and the `repository_validation` gate checker supply; a failed verdict is part of the structural failure.
- Today each view filters its own pipeline: per-issue in `run_rules` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1643-1758`), scope in `validate_scope` (`:1833-1950`), explain in `explain_rules` (`:1993-2081`), single rule in `rule_validation_outcome` (`:1114-1174`), whose `RuleSelectionFault` (`:1177-1201`) the CLI renders as one error finding and the rule checker records as an `error` run, and the gate checkers in `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:413-564`.
- Scope membership comes from `domain::queries::bracket_scope_ids` (`crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs:372`) with the container template's breakdown type; rule selection errors come from `validation::graph::select_graph_rule` (`crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:409`); explain rows use `Selector::match_failure` and `render_selector` (`commands/validate.rs:2040,2357-2376`, tests `:2851,2862`).
- The membership of each selection is fixed by the plan's `selection-membership` contract (`dev/active/9876a23a-one-validation-report/plan.md`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each report finding carries its origin, firing subject, attribution and configuration-error flag, and the wire projection is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: `ValidationReport::select(&Selection)` returns the wire `RuleReport` for `Whole`, `Issue`, `Scope` and `Rule` selections through one membership predicate, and `ValidationReport::explain` returns the `ExplainReport` for an issue. A prefix that resolves to no issue or to several fails with today's not-found or ambiguity error; a report without parsed records fails every selection but `Whole` with its structural error; a `Whole` selection from a report without history verdicts fails with a typed error; a rule that cannot be selected for the issue returns its `RuleSelectionFault`.
- [hard] REQ-03: `render_selector` and the explain grouping live in the validation layer.
- [hard] REQ-04: Example unit tests show each selection's membership on one report, including the stated changes: a scope counts a coverage child outside the container's dependency closure, an issue selection omits a configuration error fired by another issue, an issue selection omits `enforcement-drift` and keeps `rules-file`, and only `Whole` reports a failed record-fidelity or document-reference verdict.

## Notes

- Behaviour changes, delivered to users as each view adopts the selection: scope rules see the whole repository; issue and explain configuration errors narrow to the selected issue's subject or rule; issue, explain, scope and rule selections report `rules-file` for an unloadable rule set; issue and explain selections never include `enforcement-drift`.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Validation views are selections of the report
